name: Kirsten Gillibrand

issue_poll.name: Emerson College/PIX11/The Hill New York poll, Sept 23–25, 2024; Gallup national registered voters, Sept 16–28, 2024
issue_poll.note: Ranks 1–5 from the Emerson NY most-important-issue question, which published only its top five. Ranks 6–10 are the next issues by share rating them extremely important in Gallup's national poll (https://news.gallup.com/file/poll/651749/2024_10_09_Vote%20Issues%20Topline%20and%20Tabs.pdf). Health care, gun policy and abortion tied at 37%; the first two in Gallup's order were taken.

issues.position: Restore the SALT deduction; double the child tax credit
issues.note: H.R.1 raised the SALT cap to $40K and the child tax credit to $2,200, partly doing what she called for; she opposed it.

issues.position: Pass the Affordable Housing and AMI Fairness Act
issues.note: No Senate floor vote on the bill this term.

issues.position: Pass the 2024 bipartisan border bill; asylum and work-visa changes
issues.note: The bipartisan border bill was not brought back for a floor vote this term.

issues.position: Ratify the ERA; 20-year term limits for senators
issues.note: No recorded floor vote on either this term.

issues.position: Support Israel's defense, including U.S. backing

votes.bill_title: Disapproval of military bulldozer sale to Israel
votes.question: Motion to discharge

votes.bill_title: Disapproval of 1,000-pound bomb sale to Israel
votes.question: Motion to discharge

issues.note: Votes per Jewish Insider (https://jewishinsider.com/2026/04/majority-senate-democrats-vote-block-arm-sales-israel/) and Senate Democrats floor wrap-up.

issues.position: Term limits and ethics rules for justices
issues.note: No floor vote on Court term limits or ethics this term.

issues.position: Free school meals for all students; paid family leave
issues.note: No floor vote on universal school meals or paid leave this term.

issues.position: Lower prescription drug prices; protect reproductive health care
issues.note: H.R.1 exempted more orphan drugs from Medicare price negotiation and defunded Planned Parenthood for a year.

issues.position: Assault weapons ban; stronger background checks
issues.note: No recorded floor vote this term.

caveats: No ranked NY issue poll covered beyond five items; ranks 6–10 use Gallup national data, and abortion (tied at 37%) was left out by Gallup's listing order.
Economy rated Contradicted because H.R.1 partly raised SALT and the child credit; she called for more than it delivered.
Roll call numbers for the April 15, 2026 Israel arms-sale votes were not confirmed (tallies 40–59 and 36–63).
